biocs.name: Uncommon Driver Load
biocs.description: Detection of an unusual driver being loaded by a non-system process
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'services.exe' and actor_process_image_name != 'lsass.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe' and action_file_path contains 'driver.sys'

abiocs.name: Suspicious Driver Load via PowerShell
abiocs.description: PowerShell downloading and executing a driver file in a non-standard location
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'driver.sys'
